Definition: from the comparative of G3501; appertaining to younger persons, i.e. juvenile:--youthful.
BiblicalUsage: Timothy is told to flee youthful lusts and to follow righteousness and faith and love and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fleeing and following go together: the young man runs from lust and runs toward righteousness, and he does not run alone but with those who call on the Lord.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
